Hoạt động ship COD mang lại rất nhiều ưu.en: The CODship activity offers many advantages to users of this service, most of the online business units all apply this CODship form to diversify the method of paying customers, creating trust for guests. Khi bên bán đã xác nhận đơn hàng của ngư.en: When the sale confirmed the buyer's order, the next job of the seller was packing the package, contacting the transport unit receiving the CODship. Complete the delivery form form by the supply unit, including the receiver's information, the amount of carbon revenue, the type of goods...
Khi bên bán đã xác nhận đơn hàng của ngư.zh: 销售确认买方订单时,卖方的下一份工作是包装包裹,联系接收CODship的运输单位。 由供应单位填写交付表,包括接收方信息,碳收入额,商品种类.

Khi quá trình giao nhận hàng hoá, nhận t.en: When the delivery process is successful, taking the COD money, shipper will report the order complete. In accordance with the COD service of the transport unit, the amount of money will be transferred to the salesman (who sends the goods) total charge after subtracting the payment (if available), the cost of theship into the pre-registered bank account.
Khi quá trình giao nhận hàng hoá, nhận t.zh: 当交付过程成功,取下COD钱后,托运人会报告订单完成. 根据运输单位的COD服务,在扣除付款(如果有)后,资金金额将转给销售员(其发送货物)的总收费,这笔费用将转入预先登记的银行账户。

The buyer agreed to send back the COD money written on the delivery ticket, exactly the amount, the fee of theship according to the deal with the seller. If the buyer did not agree to take the item, shipper did not accept the COD money but returned the package to the seller.
Lúc này câu hỏi tiền COD là gì được trả.zh: 现在COD资金问题最明显的答案是. 交货单位在地址到达买方时提供了货物。 买方同意按照与卖方的交易,将交货票上写明的COD款项、确切金额、船舶费用退回。 如果买方不同意收货,托运人不接受COD款项,但将货包退还卖方。

What is the specific form of the CADship, the COD money often referred to? Together with the Media Liu Liu follows the shares to explain this concept you.

Trước khi tiến hành gửi hàng theo hình t.en: Prior to sending the package in the form of COD to the guests, the seller needs to check carefully on the number, the type of goods that the customers have ordered. Pack your cargo as carefully as possible. Because the product may be at risk of a breakdown in the delivery process if not well packed. Also, since it's not 100% sure the customers will take the money and we've got the money, even if we've got the application closed but the money hasn't been collected.
Trước khi tiến hành gửi hàng theo hình t.zh: 在以COD形式将包裹寄给客人之前,卖方需要仔细检查客户订购的货号,货型. 尽量小心地收拾货物 因为如果包装不齐全,产品可能面临交付过程破裂的风险。 另外,由于不能百分百地确定顾客会收钱,我们也有钱,即使我们把申请关了,但钱还没有收.
